am_intro_1: I design and ship complete, deployed applications. I'm comfortable across the stack: modern interfaces with React, Next.js and JavaScript, backed by Supabase, REST APIs and Python for scalable, secure products.
am_intro_2: My distinctive edge is interactive and 3D web: real-time product configurators and Augmented Reality experiences built with Three.js and React Three Fiber. I pair technical performance with clean, thoughtful design to deliver end-to-end solutions.
am_exp_1_text: I build end-to-end web applications with Next.js, React and JavaScript on the front, and Supabase for data, authentication and backend services. I develop real-time 3D product configurators and Augmented Reality experiences with Three.js, React Three Fiber and model-viewer, turning static catalogs into interactive tools.
am_exp_2_text: I developed interactive real-estate sales platforms with JavaScript and Supabase, deployed on Vercel. They let buyers explore apartment availability, unit details and media galleries through a fluid, responsive interface. I also optimized internal project-management workflows through asset digitalization.
am_edu_text: Specialization in modern front-end architectures, database management and web-performance optimization, with constant updates on the JavaScript ecosystem and immersive technologies.
am_cta_text: I'm open to projects, collaborations and roles where I can contribute end to end.
